description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 13.01.2020 to 19.01.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes new regulatory rates, making it a regulatory matter falling under Legal/Regulatory classification. While it names an official (A. V. Janadara), this is in the context of exercising statutory authority to implement regulatory changes, not a personnel appointment or government restructuring.
